tool_args.rationale: The short-window observations and recalled mechanism support endogenous adaptation, but do not resolve long-horizon behavior. Acquire the slow-horizon discriminating probe before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon adaptation law now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon rows do not identify its parameters robustly, and the target horizon is 22.8, where the slow adaptation term matters.
A longer-horizon observation is more directly discriminating between the recalled dual-horizon mechanisms at lower total cost.
It is unrelated to the target law and should not be purchased.
